about_the_game:
Precise Control Meets Environmental Puzzles

The precise controls, including jump, dodge, and gliding, are linked with timing-based gimmicks to provide tense platforming. Every movement made by Nia quickly translates into puzzle-solving, where players must interpret and overcome the space itself.

A Journey to Restore a Collapsed and Distorted World

The game is set in a world physically and emotionally distorted due to the contamination of the Primeval Gate. Players take on the role of Nia, a small deity, who must track the source of the corruption and purify the Primeval Gate. Through stage exploration, players visually witness the extent of the world's destruction.

Sensory Narrative and Unique Art Direction

The emotional narrative quietly unfolds and expands, stimulating the player's senses and imagination purely through direction and symbolism, without dialogue. The fairytale visuals and lively animation create a unique world where tranquility and unease coexist, offering deep immersion.
